Marissa — can you draft the proposed staging access checklist (MFA requirements, RBAC roles, sample creds rotation cadence)? Mateo / team — I reviewed the OrderForm_Clarion_v3.docx redlines and the exhibit markup. Summary of suggested legal concessions and alternative wording below. I kept the edits compact so procurement can accept faster: 

1) Inspection notice window
- Proposed: "Customer shall provide not less than fifteen (15) business days' prior written notice for any on-site or privileged remote inspection; Redwood will provide a mutually agreeable schedule and will use commercially reasonable efforts to accommodate."
- Rationale: avoids an absolute obligation to accommodate specific dates while committing to the 15-business-day baseline.

2) Pen-test and scoped IP ranges
- Proposed addendum clause: "Penetration testing is permitted only after execution of a mutually-agreed test plan that identifies target ranges (CIDR) and the designated point of contact. Customer agrees to provide test ranges and a runbook no fewer than seven (7) business days prior to the planned test window. Redwood reserves the right to pause tests that adversely affect production systems."

3) SOC 2 delivery and out-of-cycle requests
- Proposed: "Redwood will publish annual SOC 2 Type II reports and, upon material change, will provide an updated report within ten (10) business days when practicable. Where third-party redactions are required, Redwood will provide summary attestations and evidence extracts as an alternative."

4) Evidence handoff/cadence
- Operational playbook (attachment stub): timeline table — evidence request, owner, expected delivery, and sample artifacts (logs, config snapshots, MD5 manifests). Recommend weekly evidence sprints during onboarding, then monthly rotation windows for audit requests.

5) Limited liability / procurement asks
- If procurement insists on broader inspection language, recommend adding a clause that limits inspection to business hours and excludes live debugging without prior approval.

I'll attach a tracked-change version of the Order Form and a one-page playbook that Marissa can convert to an ops checklist. Marissa — please confirm the staging credential rotation frequency and whether we can provide a short-lived jump account for tests.

Olga
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
